prompt:
Generate 100 code search queries in Chinese (Simplified).

Guidelines:
- Use simplified characters (简体)
- Question patterns: 如何, 什么, 为什么, 哪里, 怎么
- Technical terms: can translate (认证) or keep English (Auth)

Category Examples:

LEXICAL (30%) - Same as English
- AuthService, getUserById, config.yml

SEMANTIC (30%) - Chinese questions
- 身份验证如何工作 (how does authentication work)
- 为什么需要缓存 (why is caching needed)
- 用户登录流程 (user login flow)
- 错误处理策略 (error handling strategy)

STRUCTURAL (20%) - Chinese + Identifier
- 什么调用AuthService (what calls AuthService)
- AuthService的依赖项 (dependencies of AuthService)
- 实现Repository的类 (classes implementing Repository)

HYBRID (20%) - Chinese Concept + Identifier
- AuthService登录流程 (AuthService login flow)
- getUserById如何处理错误 (how getUserById handles errors)

Output: JSON array [{"query": "...", "label": "...", "subtype": "..."}]
